d: Harmanpreet Kaur's India captaincy may be over, but her story in Indian cricket is far from finished. After stepping down as India's all-format captain, the veteran batter struck 126 against Zimbabwe in the second ODI, recording her eighth ODI century as India secured a 2-0 series lead. From leading India to the Women's Cricket World Cup title to adjusting to life beyond captaincy, Harmanpreet now faces a different chapter in her international career. What does it mean to lead without the armband that is now with Smriti Mandhana? Rupha Ramani explores Harmanpreet Kaur's life after…
